title: CREST
lead: Centre for Research on Start-Ups and Risk Financing — an Institute of Eminence research centre at IIT Madras.

crest.fullName: Centre for Research on Start-Ups and Risk Financing
crest.tagline: An Institute of Eminence research centre at IIT Madras
crest.dept: Department of Management Studies, IIT Madras
about: India's startup boom has been driven largely by policy and practice. CREST exists to add academic evidence — so investment decisions, incubation programmes and public schemes rest on data, not anecdote.

The centre studies innovation, entrepreneurship and risk capital. It builds unique datasets on ventures and investors, publishes scholarly work, and works with ministries, incubators and banks on applied studies.

SIE and CREST sit in the same campus ecosystem. Faculty who mentor SIE founders also advise CREST research, and SIE's PhD programme draws on the same questions: how ventures form, raise and scale in India.

pillars.title: Scholarly research
pillars.desc: New work on innovation, entrepreneurship and risk capital, aimed at top-tier journals and Indian evidence.

pillars.title: Data platform
pillars.desc: A repository on venturing and risk capital — the missing infrastructure for high-quality research in India.

pillars.title: Evidence for practice
pillars.desc: Impact studies with incubators, investor networks and government missions, grounded in real programme data.

pillars.title: Thought leadership
pillars.desc: Reports, dashboards and convenings that put research in front of policymakers and operators.

domains.name: Venture science
domains.desc: How early-stage firms form, hire and survive.

domains.name: Risk capital
domains.desc: Valuation, venture capital and the cost of capital for Indian startups.

domains.name: Incubation & policy
domains.desc: What public schemes and incubators actually change for founders.

domains.name: Deep-tech ecosystems
domains.desc: Lab-to-market paths, IP and university-linked ventures.

domains.name: Sector platforms
domains.desc: National dashboards for biotech, textiles, education and more.

domains.name: Impact & inclusion
domains.desc: Health equity, circular economy and grassroots enterprise.

studies.title: Valuing early-stage startups
studies.desc: A machine-learning comparable-company model for early-stage valuation, using CREST's startup datasets instead of cash-flow forecasts that young firms cannot support.

studies.title: Biotech startup dashboard
studies.desc: A national view of biotech startups, founders and funding — built on CREST platforms such as VIBGYOR and ONE-INNOVATION.

studies.title: Ubharte Sitaare impact
studies.desc: Before-and-after social impact assessment of companies supported under the Ubharte Sitaare programme, using an additionalities framework.

studies.title: GRID grassroots enterprises
studies.desc: Socio-economic outcomes of community enterprises in handloom, pottery, agriculture and rural manufacturing.

studies.title: MeitY TIDE 2.0 assessment
studies.desc: Impact evaluation of the TIDE 2.0 incubation scheme — revenue, jobs, follow-on capital and IP, triangulated with incubator and founder discussions.

studies.title: Tamil Nadu startup ecosystem
studies.desc: A state-level snapshot of policy, funding and founder outcomes, aligned with Startup India.

studies.title: Patents and startup performance
studies.desc: How intellectual property relates to survival, fundraising and competitive advantage in the Indian startup ecosystem.

studies.title: Student startups from HEIs
studies.desc: Which founder backgrounds, team traits and campus factors predict success for student ventures.
